limitations: No Digital Macaroni hands-on site build or publish test was completed.
Current pricing includes promotional two-year and lifetime offers that may change.
Review pools favor ease and value, while reliability complaints are less common but important for a live website.

claims.statement: Dorik builds no-code landing pages, small-business sites, blogs, and sites managed for clients.
Current monthly prices are $29 for Personal, $59 for Business, and $99 for Agency. Yearly and two-year terms lower the effective monthly cost.

The current trial lasts seven days. Personal supports one custom domain and 25 pages; Business supports three custom domains, unlimited pages, and ten collaborators; Agency supports unlimited domains and collaborators.
Fast first-site creation, a simple editor, templates, reusable blocks, value, and helpful support are the strongest repeated positives.
Advanced design work, integrations, complex selling, and final responsive polish can exceed Dorik's comfortable range.
A smaller group describes bugs, slow pages, domain or rendering trouble, downtime, and slow support during incidents.

scoreRationale.onboarding: The builder, templates, blocks, and AI can produce a useful first page quickly.
scoreRationale.product: Strong for a simple marketing site, but the last round of design polish and more complex site needs can expose limits.
scoreRationale.support: Support is praised more often than criticized, though incident response is mixed.
scoreRationale.billing: Several billing terms and live promotions make the page harder to compare than the product needs to be.
scoreRationale.overall: Dorik is a good fit for a simple site that can stay within its editor. Build the hardest real page during the trial before paying for a long term.

conflictsAndUnknowns: Support is often praised, but some incident accounts describe slow replies.
AI makes the first draft fast, while final mobile and desktop polish may take manual work.
No publish, domain, form, speed, restore, or support test was completed.
